body: @romilpunetha can you link to a reproducer or upload one inside the issue ? This would help us on it a lot.

@loicmathieu Here it is: https://github.com/romilpunetha/quarkus-mongo-panache-demo/tree/main/mongodb-panache-quickstart The following is the annotation on my UserEntity class: `@MongoEntity(database = "userDB", collection = "users")` However, the db is created using the base db config: `quarkus.mongodb.database=Users`

@loicmathieu Did you get a chance to look into this? 
We're about to move our workloads to production and it'd be difficult moving the collections into their respective DBs later.

issue.title: MongoDB Panache reactive: database name is not taken from the annotation

body:
Hi @romilpunetha there is indead a bug inside the reactive implementation that didn't take the database name from the entity.
I provided a PR to fix it.
